description: This Java source file defines the EntityCacheServices class, which provides cache management services for entity caching, including distributed cache clearing operations within the Apache OFBiz framework.

classes.name: EntityCacheServices
classes.description: Provides methods for cache management, including clearing cache lines and performing distributed cache operations within OFBiz.

methods.name: setDelegator
methods.description: Sets the Delegator and Dispatcher instances for cache management operations.

methods.name: getAuthUserLogin
methods.description: Retrieves the current authenticated user login information from the database.

methods.name: distributedClearCacheLine
methods.description: Performs an asynchronous distributed cache clear operation for a specific cache line identified by a value.

methods.name: distributedClearCacheLineFlexible
methods.description: Performs an asynchronous distributed cache clear operation based on a dummy primary key.

methods.name: distributedClearCacheLineByCondition
methods.description: Performs an asynchronous distributed cache clear based on an entity condition.

methods.name: distributedClearCacheLineByPrimaryKey
methods.description: Performs an asynchronous distributed cache clear by primary key.

methods.name: clearAllCaches
methods.description: Clears all caches, optionally distributing the operation.

methods.name: clearCacheLine
methods.description: Service method to clear a specific cache line based on context parameters like value, dummyPK, primaryKey, or condition.
